time_conversion: Shared pinned-SPICE UTC-to-TDB conversion; split-JD TDB supplied to Skyfield. Historical pre-1972 dates follow the SPICE extended UTC convention.
accuracy_scope: These comparison bounds concern implementation agreement, not physical ephemeris uncertainty, absolute site knowledge or map registration.

local_hosted_adapter_integration.scope: Local TestClient through the actual hosted Vercel adapter and a private Python interpreter, without an injected planner; not a deployed-host measurement.

reproduction_method.time: ET=utc_to_et(epoch) under the matched SPICE context; t=SkyfieldTimescale.tdb_jd(2451545.0, ET/86400.0). This step is shared rather than independently verified.
reproduction_method.rotation: Read moon_080317.tf and moon_pa_de421_1900-2050.bpc with Skyfield.PlanetaryConstants; build MOON_ME_DE421; R,Rdot_day=frame.rotation_and_rate_at(t). The rate method uses split-JD precision.
reproduction_method.site_elevation: Subtract exported panel_position_m for Sun and antenna_position_m for Earth; independently form elementary spherical east/north/up components; elevation=atan2(up,hypot(east,north)). At the exact pole use longitude zero for the basis.
reproduction_method.lro_frame_check: Evaluate pinned LRO SPK using native CSPICE spkezr(-85,ET,J2000,NONE,MOON), convert km and km/s to SI, and apply independent Skyfield R/Rdot as above. This checks the PCK/frame transformation, while SPK evaluation remains shared.
reproduction_method.sources: No network fetch during calculations; verify the recorded source hashes before repeating.
